title: Simultaneous universal rank-matched direct-image locus
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume the canonical adjunction unit at the structure sheaf [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] is invertible after every base change. Let $\mathcal E$ be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. There is an immersion $j:W\to S$, locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, such that for every $g:T\to S$, a factorization of $g$ through $j$ exists if and only if $P(f,\mathcal E,g)$ holds [def-sc-picard-direct-image-rank-condition]. No evaluation isomorphism or descent of $\mathcal E$ is asserted.

proof.text: The unit hypothesis gives nonempty connected fibres, using their field-valued global functions and idempotents. Take the open-and-closed rank loci of E in X. Their images are open by flat finite presentation and closed by properness. They give disjoint open-and-closed rank components S_r covering S.

On S_r, E and its dual have rank r, are finitely presented, and are flat relative to S. Their derived direct images are perfect and commute with arbitrary base change. They have no negative cohomology after any base change; choose local finite-free models with Tor amplitude [0,b].

Apply the universal lowest-cohomology rank-r locus to both direct images, and take their fibre product. The canonical degree-zero base-change maps are invertible on this locus by the cohomology-pullback clause of that result. Conversely P gives both universal rank-r conditions after restriction to S_r, so it gives both factorizations. Glue by the unique representing identifications over affine overlaps, then take the disjoint union over S_r. Finite presentation and immersion are local on the target; quasi-compact target opens meet only finitely many rank components. Immersions are separated and hence quasi-separated.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picardDirectImageRankLocus {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ S),
      IsImmersion j ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation j ∧ QuasiCompact j ∧
      QuasiSeparated j ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
        (∃ h : T ⟶ W, h ≫ j = g) ↔ PicardDirectImageRankCondition f E g
